nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: GNU Make recipe that compiles SecStoreAccess.java and SecStoreAccessException.java into decrypt-ssfs.jar, the JNI helper used by SAPMAP to decrypt SAP Cloud Connector SSFS secret stores via libsapscc20jni at runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Makefile uses ?= for tool overrides (JAVAC, JAR) and links against SAP's native lib only at runtime — no SAP code is compiled or redistributed.

nodes.name: build.bat
nodes.summary: Windows batch build script equivalent to the Makefile — compiles the SecStoreAccess JNI helper sources into decrypt-ssfs.jar using a system JDK with explicit errorlevel checks after javac and jar.

nodes.name: build.sh
nodes.summary: Portable POSIX shell build script (Linux + macOS, arm64 + x86_64) that compiles the SecStoreAccess JNI helper sources into decrypt-ssfs.jar using only a JDK on PATH, no make required.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses set -euo pipefail and cd "$(dirname "$0")" so the script works from any invocation directory.
